title: FeverPAIN
subtitle: Acute sore-throat antibiotic decision support
summary: FeverPAIN supports antibiotic decisions in acute sore throat alongside assessment for airway compromise, deep-neck infection and sepsis.

criteria.label: Attend rapidly: symptoms began within the previous 3 days

results.label: Consider no or back-up antibiotic
interpretation: Consider no antibiotic or a back-up prescription according to the clinical picture and local antimicrobial guidance.

results.label: Consider antibiotic
interpretation: Consider an immediate or back-up antibiotic according to the clinical picture and local antimicrobial guidance.

overrides: Escalate for stridor, drooling, inability to swallow fluids, trismus, unilateral palatal swelling, uvular deviation, neck swelling, respiratory distress, hypotension, altered mental state or rapidly progressive symptoms.
Follow the Northern Ireland Primary Care Antimicrobial MicroGuide.
limitations: The score does not exclude epiglottitis, peritonsillar abscess, retropharyngeal infection or sepsis.
